content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue with mapping network outputs to a KTP 600 panel while working with two [product_name] modules configured as master/slave. The digital outputs are visualized on the KTP 600 without problems. However, I am unable to make the network outputs function properly. If anyone could assist me with this, I would appreciate it. Thanks in advance. [user_name]

Hello [user_name], In the software, link the network output to a flag (for example, M4). Then, on the HMI panel, create a tag using the appropriate address (for example, M0.3), and visualize the output using this variable. If you have additional questions, feel free to ask. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports difficulty visualizing network outputs from two [product_name] modules set up as master/slave with a KTP 600 panel. Digital outputs are working and displayed correctly, but network outputs are not. Another user explains how to assign network outputs to flags/variables and configure the HMI panel to visualize these flags, providing helpful guidance on variable assignment for output mapping.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to visualize and use network outputs from two [product_name] modules on the KTP 600 HMI panel similarly to digital outputs.
